performance_note.subject: Repeated source-prefix hashing
performance_note.evidence: Fresh real-file builds at 32 notes/63 nodes called _note_encoding 4000 times; 64 notes/127 nodes called it 16192 times. Asserted measured formula (2 * node_count - 1) * note_count for full builds. Every restored node also validates its full saved prefix.
